name: Token Intel — Crypto Intelligence
description: Structured crypto token intelligence: price, market cap, volume, liquidity, DEX pairs, sentiment and AI summary for any ticker or contract address. $0.005–$0.02/query via x402.
longDescription: Given a ticker (ETH, BTC, SOL) or a token contract address, returns structured JSON with price, market cap, 24h volume, supply, ATH (CoinGecko), DEX pairs + liquidity (DexScreener), a deterministic momentum/attention sentiment score, and — when the operator configures a DeepSeek key — an AI summary and interest signal (is it gaining volume/attention?). Works for majors and brand-new degen tokens not yet on CoinGecko. No KYC, no subscription: agents pay USDC per request on Solana.
